mainEntity.name: Do you offer same-day alterations in Sharjah?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Selected alterations and repairs can be completed on the same day depending on garment type and current workload.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a fitting through WhatsApp?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Customers can request a fitting or alteration appointment through WhatsApp, phone, or the booking page.

mainEntity.name: What makes Green Stitch Tailoring sustainable?

acceptedAnswer.text: We prioritize repair before replacement, offer lower-waste alterations, and help customers extend the life of garments with fabric-conscious tailoring.
